verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no dedicated export feature, but leaving is plausible through other routes. The Admin API covers anything the dashboard can do, which allows programmatic extraction of projects, flags, segments and users. Flagsmith is open source on GitHub and can be self-hosted (including via Docker) with 'full control over your data', and audit logs can be streamed into your own infrastructure via webhooks. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of all data, explicit open/standard export formats, a documented migration/off-boarding path, and independent hands-on corroboration of a successful exit.
